justification: Both surfaces carry profile animals carved in flat raised relief, stacked one above another in a vertical sequence up a tall tapering upright with plain background and identical outline-and-flat-infill conventions, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. The main difference in content is that B presents a much fuller, register-divided programme including a horizontal band of repeated linear signs, birds with hooked beaks, a long-necked bird and other varied creatures, whereas A shows only a couple of quadrupeds with no framing band or bird imagery visible.
